chapter.en: Chapter I · The light is still on

premise.zh: 核爆终结文明纪元，幸存者在废土纪元重建生活。长潮退去，散落的影像被带回映汐放映站。灯外还有聚落、理想城与尚未走过的路。
premise.en: Nuclear destruction ended the Civilization Era; survivors rebuild in the Wasteland Era. After the Long Tide receded, scattered images returned to Yingxi Station. Beyond its light lie settlements, Ideal City, and unwalked roads.

description.zh: 旧铁路线的最后一间放映室。长潮之后，幸存的影像在这里归档，流浪的人可以借一晚灯光。
description.en: The last projection room on an old railway. After the Long Tide, surviving images are catalogued here; travelers may borrow its light for a night.

description.zh: 盐壳包住停运的车厢，弥途把能走的路画在车门内侧。这里的地图会褪色，人却总会回来补上一笔。
description.en: Salt crusts the abandoned carriages. Mitu marks passable routes inside their doors. The maps fade; someone always returns to redraw a line.

description.zh: 回声海退潮时露出的圆形屋顶。拾荒者带回过它的胶片盒，馆内还有多少层，没人说得准。
description.en: A circular roof exposed at low tide. Scavengers have brought back its film cans; no one agrees how many floors remain beneath them.

description.zh: 潮水没过旧城，风把废弃广播送回岸上。迟灯说，海声里偶尔会多出一个本不该存在的频道。
description.en: The old city lies under tidal water. Wind carries abandoned broadcasts ashore. Chideng says an impossible extra channel sometimes slips between the waves.

description.zh: 北脊山后的微光，只在无云的夜里出现。它是另一座有人值守的站，还是长潮留下的残像？信笺里暂时没有答案。
description.en: A glimmer beyond the northern ridge, visible only on clear nights. Another staffed station, or an afterimage of the Long Tide? The letters hold no answer yet.

role.zh: 影像拾荒者 · 据点管理员

description.zh: 旧风镜与拼装头灯压在帽檐上，灰绿工装补着回收布料，口袋里总有一颗不配套的螺丝。撬拆工具、呼吸防护与胶片罐挂在胸前；嘴上嫌修理麻烦，却从不肯把还能放映的影像留在雨里。
description.en: Old goggles and a jury-rigged headlamp on her cap; salvaged cloth patches across grey-green workwear, one mismatched screw in every pocket. Pry tools, breathing protection and film canisters hang from her harness. Complains about repairs; never leaves a playable image out in the rain.

quotes.zh: 先别说它坏了。给我一盏灯。
quotes.en: Don’t call it broken yet. Bring me a lamp.

quotes.zh: 带回来的不只是片子，还有回去的路。
quotes.en: We bring back more than films. We bring a way home.

quotes.zh: 这一格修好了。今晚应该能早一点开场。
quotes.en: That part is fixed. We might start a little earlier tonight.

quotes.zh: 哟，回来了。今天淘着啥好货了？
quotes.en: Back again? What good finds did you bring today?

quotes.zh: 这批影像登记好了，片架给你留了位置。
quotes.en: These images are logged. There is room for them on the shelf.

quotes.zh: 字放清楚些。路还长，慢慢读。
quotes.en: Keep the writing clear. There is a long road ahead; take your time reading.

quotes.zh: 片罐的标签写在侧面。盖子磨花了，名字也不会跟着丢。
quotes.en: Put the label on the side of the film can. A worn lid should not take its name with it.

role.zh: 放映站守夜人 · 旧设备修理师

description.zh: 灰白的鬓角，补过三次的耳机；旧工装外罩着磨损的维修围裙，表笔、电线和钳子各有落脚处。提灯用回收金属拼了护网。他记得每台放映机的脾气，却总忘记自己的茶已经凉了。
description.en: Grey at the temples, headphones patched three times. A worn repair apron over old coveralls, with a place for meter probes, wire and pliers. Scrap metal guards his work light. Remembers every projector’s temperament; forgets the tea.

quotes.zh: 灯亮着，就还有人知道往哪儿走。
quotes.en: While the light is on, someone still knows the way.

quotes.zh: 锁扣收好了。幕布是留给影像的。
quotes.en: The clasp is put away. The screen belongs to the picture.

quotes.zh: 别急，先听它转完这一圈。
quotes.en: No hurry. Listen until it makes one full turn.

quotes.zh: 先把设备调顺，今晚安心看。
quotes.en: Get the equipment settled, then enjoy tonight’s screening.

quotes.zh: 灯可以换，片子的底色不能认错。
quotes.en: You can change the lamp. You must still read the picture's colors correctly.

quotes.zh: 转轴修好了。你看你的，我把守夜灯留着。
quotes.en: The pivot is fixed. Keep watching; I'll leave the night lamp on.

quotes.zh: 银幕上的人动起来，我才敢把工具收回箱里。
quotes.en: I'll put the tools away when the people on the screen start moving.

quotes.zh: 幕布展开了，坐吧。
quotes.en: The screen is open. Take a seat.

quotes.zh: 线接好了。歇会儿也成，回来接着放。
quotes.en: The line is patched. Take a break; the next reel can wait for you.

quotes.zh: 旧零件别急着扔。先认清哪块该干什么活。
quotes.en: Don't throw the old parts away yet. First work out which one belongs on which job.

quotes.zh: 垫圈按尺寸串在细铁丝上。合不上，拧得再紧也不会稳。
quotes.en: Sort the washers on a thin wire by size. Tightening the wrong one will not make it fit.

role.zh: 盐环路标师 · 往返列站的递信人

description.zh: 短发间别着一支褪色的红铅笔，短雨披和背架上尽是修补痕迹，绳索、片罐与水壶沿着橙色肩带固定。地图贴身收着，罗盘从不离手。她把没走过的路线画成虚线，不愿把猜测当成路。
description.en: A faded red pencil tucked into short hair, repairs across her short rain poncho and pack frame. Rope, film canisters and a flask are secured beside an orange strap. Keeps the map close and the compass at hand. Unwalked routes stay dotted: a guess is no road to send someone down.

quotes.zh: 没走过的路，我会画成虚线。
quotes.en: A road I haven’t walked gets a dotted line.

quotes.zh: 地图可以旧，路标不能含糊。
quotes.en: A map may age. A signpost must stay clear.

quotes.zh: 下一封信，等我过了盐环再寄。
quotes.en: The next letter goes out once I cross the Salt Ring.

text.zh: 守夜人把锁扣收进口袋，让影像占回幕布。
text.en: The night keeper pocketed the clasp, returning the screen to the picture.

text.zh: 柜台展开第一张图谱。拾荒者与守夜人留下名字，盐环的递信人也有了自己的声音。
text.en: The first atlas opens on the counter. Scavenger and night keeper leave their names; the Salt Ring runner finds a voice of her own.

text.zh: 阿汐把「映汐放映室」的新名牌钉上门楣，又把档案室的指示牌挪到门外。迟灯擦亮了耳机上的铜线，弥途终于让画师留下了那支红铅笔。
text.en: Axi fixed the new Yingxi Screening Room sign above the door and moved the archives sign outside. Chideng polished the copper on his headphones; Mitu finally persuaded the portrait artist to keep her red pencil.

text.zh: 三人的肖像重新挂回档案室。阿汐带着拆解工具，迟灯提起拼装工作灯，弥途没有卸下背架；门后的冷光照见每一道补丁。
text.en: Three repainted portraits return to the archives: Axi with her salvage tools, Chideng with a rebuilt work light, Mitu still carrying her pack frame. The cool light beyond the door reveals every patch.

text.zh: 阿汐开始登记每天的新拾获；迟灯从幕布右侧递来一句话，弥途把外部避难所的路标擦亮。
text.en: Axi logs each day’s new finds. Chideng offers a few words from the screen’s edge, while Mitu freshens the sign to the outer shelters.

text.zh: 阿汐重新铺平柜台的信纸，档案边的一圈圆线标记着正在读的来信。
text.en: Axi laid the counter's letter flat again. A circular mark beside the records shows which letter is open.

text.zh: 阿汐把散落在旧信上的短句归回档案，又将词笺上的既有记录、传闻与待议事项分别注明。弥途没有把虚线改成实线。
text.en: Axi returned lines from old letters to the archives and marked the dictionary’s records, rumors, and proposals separately. Mitu left the dotted routes dotted.

boundary.zh: 图谱呈现原创故事，不代表联网片库或已开放功能。虚线保留未证实线索；词典中的「演进提案」尚非既定事实。当前仅有第一章，第二章保留为方案。
boundary.en: The atlas is original fiction, separate from connected libraries and available features. Dotted lines preserve unconfirmed leads; dictionary extensions marked “Proposal” are not established facts. Only Chapter I is present; Chapter II remains a plan.

summary.zh: 核爆毁灭之前的旧文明时代；具体年代与技术全貌尚未确定。
summary.en: The era of the old civilization before nuclear destruction; its dates and full technological scope remain unspecified.

summary.zh: 核爆导致文明纪元终结，随后进入废土纪元。起因、次数、范围与距今年数尚未确定。
summary.en: Nuclear destruction ended the Civilization Era and preceded the Wasteland Era. Its causes, number of detonations, extent, and date remain unspecified.

summary.zh: 文明纪元毁灭后的时代，多种聚居形态与生命形态并存。
summary.en: The era after the destruction of the Civilization Era, with diverse settlements and forms of life.

summary.zh: 居民对文明纪元及其遗存的日常称呼。
summary.en: The everyday name for the Civilization Era and what survives from it.

summary.zh: 既有故事中的潮水事件，与旧城被淹、盐壳和退潮后的影像遗存相连；不等同于核爆。
summary.en: The tidal event associated with the flooded old city, salt crusts, and surviving images exposed by receding water; it is distinct from the nuclear destruction.

proposal.zh: 可发展为断代后的区域性海侵与城市积水史；与核爆的时间间隔、地质和气候成因待定。
proposal.en: It may develop into a regional history of marine incursions and flooding after the break; its timing and geological or climatic causes remain proposed.

summary.zh: 废土世界中存在的实体避难与居住据点。应用中的同名入口另指远程媒体连接。
summary.en: Physical places of refuge and habitation in the wasteland. The app uses the same name separately for remote media connections.

proposal.zh: 可由灾前防护设施或灾后工程延续而来；地下结构、维生设备和治理方式逐处设定。放映站尚未确定属于地下避难所。
proposal.en: They may continue pre-disaster protective facilities or later construction; underground layouts, life-support systems, and governance must be established individually. The station is not established as an underground shelter.

summary.zh: 灾后幸存者形成的生活共同体，与避难所和理想城等形态并存。
summary.en: Communities formed by survivors after the disaster, coexisting with shelters and Ideal City.

proposal.zh: 可围绕水源、农业、铁路和工坊发展；与其他共同体交换物资、维修服务和消息。
proposal.en: They may grow around water, farming, railways, and workshops, exchanging goods, repairs, and news with other communities.

summary.zh: 已确认存在的城市设定。位置、数量、制度、技术水平及与放映站的通路尚未确定。
summary.en: An established city concept. Its location, number, institutions, technology, and routes to the station remain unspecified.

proposal.zh: 可先按一座保留部分工业能力的城市展开，以能源、净水和精密维修联系周边共同体；制度与贸易细节待定。
proposal.en: It may first be developed as a city retaining some industrial capacity, connected to its neighbors through energy, clean water, and precision repairs; its institutions and trade remain proposed.

summary.zh: 废土中存在受辐射影响而产生变化的生命；具体物种、生态习性与危险程度尚未逐一设定。
summary.en: Forms of life changed by radiation exist in the wasteland; individual species, ecology, and hazards have not yet been established.

proposal.zh: 可按谱系与生境分别扩展，保留捕食、共生和驯养等不同关系；不把所有变异生命设成同一种性情。
proposal.en: They may be developed by lineage and habitat, with predatory, symbiotic, or domesticated relationships rather than one universal temperament.

summary.zh: 已确认存在的生命概念，其起源、进化机制、栖息地与能力边界尚未确定。
summary.en: An established life concept whose origin, evolutionary mechanism, habitats, and limits remain unspecified.

proposal.zh: 可按具有传播、群落重组与环境适应阶段的生态系统展开。吸附污染物不等于消除放射性；尚无保护胶片或吸收电磁信号的既定能力。
proposal.en: It may develop as an ecosystem with dispersal, community recombination, and adaptation stages. Binding pollutants does not eliminate radioactivity; protecting film or feeding on electromagnetic signals is not an established ability.

summary.zh: 废土中存在的人形生命或人群设定；身体特征、社会身份和个体经历需要分别展开。
summary.en: An established humanoid life or population concept; physical traits, social identities, and individual histories require separate development.

proposal.zh: 可作为人类谱系中的稳定变异人群发展；职业、体能和立场由个体决定，不统一指定为铁匠、搬运者或敌人。
proposal.en: They may develop as stable variant populations within the human lineage; profession, strength, and outlook belong to individuals rather than a universal role.

summary.zh: 已确认存在的生命或能力概念，能力来源、谱系归属与作用范围尚未确定。
summary.en: An established life or ability concept; the origin, lineage, and scope of its abilities remain unspecified.

proposal.zh: 建议把觉醒视为可跨谱系出现的状态，并规定消耗、恢复与感知边界；直接感知无线电或修复音轨均未确认为能力。
proposal.en: Awakening may be treated as a state across lineages, with explicit costs, recovery, and perceptual limits; direct radio perception and audio repair are not established powers.

summary.zh: 搜集、辨认和保存散落影像的人；阿汐拥有这一身份。
summary.en: Someone who gathers, identifies, and preserves scattered images; this is one of Axi’s established roles.

summary.zh: 记录通行条件并维护路标的人；弥途将未走过的路线画成虚线。
summary.en: Someone who records travel conditions and maintains signs; Mitu marks unwalked routes with dotted lines.

summary.zh: 在地点之间递送消息的人；弥途往返盐环列站。
summary.en: Someone who carries messages between places; Mitu travels to and from the Salt Ring Stops.

summary.zh: 旧铁路线上的放映与影像归档据点，阿汐和迟灯在此工作。阿汐给旧片罐补写侧签，迟灯照看放映设备。迟灯把检修拆下的垫圈按尺寸串在细铁丝上，免得混用。
summary.en: A screening and image archive on the old railway, where Axi and Chideng work. Axi renews labels on old film cans while Chideng tends the projection equipment. Chideng sorts washers from repairs on a thin wire by size so they do not get mixed up.

proposal.zh: 可逐步发展为聚落间的公共影像档案节点；具体建筑结构与自治制度尚未确定。
proposal.en: It may grow into a shared image archive between communities; its architecture and local governance remain unspecified.

summary.zh: 盐壳包住停运车厢的已知地点，弥途在这里维护通行路标。
summary.en: An established place of salt-crusted railway carriages where Mitu maintains route markers.

proposal.zh: 可发展为铁路聚落与递信中转地；多座避难所、商队和理想城通路尚未确认为已通行路线。
proposal.en: It may develop as a railway community and letter relay; routes to multiple shelters, caravans, or Ideal City are not established.

summary.zh: 第一章地点与联系的记录。实线标确认信路，虚线保留传闻。
summary.en: A record of Chapter I places and connections. Solid lines mark an established letter route; dotted lines preserve rumors.

summary.zh: 按应用版本选录的据点变化，不是完整版本史或废土年表。
summary.en: Selected station changes recorded by app version, rather than a complete release history or wasteland chronology.

summary.zh: 记录每版实际改动的更新说明，人物动作或语录放在末尾。
summary.en: Release notes describing actual changes, with a character moment or quote at the end.

summary.zh: 回声海退潮时露出的圆形屋顶。拾荒者带回过它的胶片盒，馆内还有多少层，没人说得准。
summary.en: A circular roof exposed at low tide. Scavengers have brought back its film cans; no one agrees how many floors remain beneath them.

summary.en: The old city lies under tidal water. Wind carries abandoned broadcasts ashore. Chideng says an impossible extra channel sometimes slips between the waves.
